advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Import `CLOSE_CLASSES` from `rebar._commands.txn` instead of hardcoding `_VALID_CLASSES` so the guard cannot drift from the single source of truth.
evidence: tests/unit/test_reconcile_bridge_canary_class.py:31-42: `# Valid bug-close classes per \`rebar transition --help\` (ticket ed13). _VALID_CLASSES = { ... }`

src/rebar/_commands/txn.py:159-174: `# Single-sourced here so the CLI parser, the close guard, and the completion-gate pre-check all validate against the SAME list ... CLOSE_CLASSES: tuple[str, ...] = ( ... )`
resolve_symbol: `rebar._commands.txn.CLOSE_CLASSES` EXISTS and is importable, so the test could import the canonical list instead of re-declaring it.
advisory.finding: The test hardcodes `_VALID_CLASSES` as a literal set duplicating the single-sourced `CLOSE_CLASSES` vocabulary; if ed13's class list changes upstream, `test_bug_close_class_values_are_valid` silently drifts and stops matching what `rebar transition` actually accepts.
advisory.suggested_fix: Replace the `_VALID_CLASSES` literal with `from rebar._commands.txn import CLOSE_CLASSES` and use `set(CLOSE_CLASSES)`.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Apply the same comment-stripping (`_command_text`) when selecting bug-close steps in `_bug_close_steps()` so selection and assertion scan the same command text.
evidence: tests/unit/test_reconcile_bridge_canary_class.py:71-73: `run = step.get("run", "") ... if re.search(r"rebar transition\b", run) and "closed" in run and "--force-close" in run:` — filters on raw run including comment lines.

tests/unit/test_reconcile_bridge_canary_class.py:50-59: `_command_text` deliberately strips comment lines to avoid false matches on '--class' — but the step-selection filter does not apply the same stripping.
.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge-canary.yml:289 and 406: comment lines contain '--force-close' text that the selection filter would match.
advisory.finding: `_bug_close_steps()` selects steps by scanning the RAW `run` text (comments included) for `--force-close`, but the workflow's close steps carry comment lines that literally mention `--force-close`; a step that references the flag only in a comment (never invoking it) would be misclassified as a bug-close step, weakening the guard's precision.
advisory.suggested_fix: In `_bug_close_steps()`, compute `cmd = _command_text(step)` and run the `rebar transition` / `closed` / `--force-close` predicate against `cmd` instead of the raw `run`.
